dedupe_keys.name: pynumad wind turbine blade design translator

description: pyNuMAD is a Python tool developed by Sandia National Laboratories for preparing three-dimensional wind-turbine blade models. It organises blade geometry, aerodynamic details, material properties and layup locations, then exports structured inputs to engineering tools such as ANSYS, Cubit and OpenFAST. Users provide blade specifications in YAML, Excel or XML and select a target analysis workflow; outputs are model geometry and input files for the chosen solver. Geographic scope is a user-defined turbine design, not a mapped region; time coverage follows any subsequent simulation. BSD-3-Clause source, examples and documentation are public. A limitation is that pyNuMAD prepares the model representation but does not itself certify structural life or aerodynamic performance; linked solvers and verification remain necessary. It can support wind-generation asset design and failure studies. The catalogue's model-wtdigitwin-wind-turbine-digital-twin is a distinct operational wind-asset model; interoperability was not tested. No blade file or software package was downloaded.
